# H2.6a / m-2 — the recording model

Status: design-gate packet for the second production rung of the
[h2-6a ladder](h2-6a.md#8-implementation-ladder). It replaces the dormant
statement-level hook seam with the upstream recording model on the
printer's recursive (Canonical) arm, proven corpus-inert by full-pipeline
replays of every parity witness map. Production constructs no recording:
`execute.rs` is untouched and the corpus ratchet stays byte-identical.

## 1. Identity, purpose, and boundary

- **Slice ID / kind:** `h2-6a-m-2`, kind `foundation` (crate bytes:
  `crates/emitter/src/printer.rs` + `writer.rs` + `source_map.rs` +
  `lib.rs` + the new suite → h1 ladder + chain walk re-mint).
- **Purpose:** (1) the `SourceMapRecording` value state (current source +
  registered-index memo + the m-1 generator) carried as
  `TextWriter.recording: Option<SourceMapRecording>` — zero signature
  churn across the 114 `writer:` threads; (2) node-boundary recording at
  the TWO chokepoints that bracket every recursive emission, replacing
  the statement-level pair (whose AfterNode-after-trailing-comments
  ordering diverges from upstream — fixed by construction); (3) token
  recording via the §4 ROUTE TABLE mirroring upstream's exact five-site
  `writeToken` surface plus the pipelined token-node pairs (a
  brace-guarded boundary bracket + the enumerated direct-write sites;
  synthetic cursors record only under a range override); (4) comment
  recording at the ONE source-comment writer (11 sites; synthetic
  comments unrecorded, as upstream); (5) `NO_NESTED_SOURCE_MAPS`
  suppression carried on the recording state (`suppressed_depth`,
  upstream's save/restore shape — it must reach token and comment
  records, which see no `EmitContext`); (6) deletion of the
  replaced seam (`SourceMapRecorder`/`DisabledSourceMapRecorder`/
  `SourceMapHookEvent`/`SourceMapHookPhase` and the identity-arm
  token-stream recording); (7) the full-pipeline witness replay suite.
- **Non-goals:** any production activation (`execute.rs`/`plan.rs`/
  `artifact.rs`/`outcome.rs`/`activity.rs` untouched; the `sourceMap`
  refusal stays); map serialization/writing/URL/metadata (m-3);
  the system-helper splice interaction (named hazard, §12 → m-3);
  `sourcesContent`/inline (H2.6b).
- **Prerequisites:** merged `h2-6a` (cce33a37) and `h2-6a-m-1`
  (`1ccfc0ce`, verified `git rev-parse`).
- **Trusted base:** `1ccfc0cee3047cf3d507a85ad8e78ef153985083` (the #474 merge, current `main`,
  from `git rev-parse HEAD` at branch cut).
- **Activation state:** before — recording exists only as the dormant
  coarse seam; after — the printer records upstream-exactly whenever a
  `SourceMapRecording` is injected, and NOTHING injects one in
  production (the suite injects per-case); corpus ratchet byte-identical.
- **Next owner:** `h2-6a-m-3` (runtime flip).

## 2. The empirically confirmed recording model

Decoding the frozen witness mappings against their sources (the
`plain-program--positive-statements` stream is reproduced in the review
record) confirms the pinned upstream semantics
([h2-6a.md §4.3](h2-6a.md#43-recording-sites-inside-the-printer-createprinter-_tscjs116912)):

1. **Node boundaries dominate.** Every pipeline-emitted node records
   Before at `skipTrivia(sourceMapRange.pos)` (after leading comments)
   and After at `sourceMapRange.end` (before trailing comments).
   Keywords (`var`, `if`, `return`, `=`) never map on their own.
2. **The token surface is exactly five upstream `writeToken` sites**
   (grep-complete over `_tsc.js`): the `emitTokenWithComment` BRACE arm
   (118748-118749 — `{`/`}` only; EVERY other token in that function
   goes through `writeTokenText`, unmapped), the function-body close
   brace (119030), the `debugger` keyword (118931), the meta-property
   keyword (118571), and the SINGLE-STATEMENT clause colon (119491 —
   the multi-statement clause colon takes the `emitTokenWithComment`
   arm at 119495 and is therefore UNMAPPED; the polarity is part of
   the model). Function-body OPEN braces are `writePunctuation` —
   unmapped — while their close braces map: the decoded streams show
   precisely this asymmetry. Separately, upstream PIPELINES certain
   token NODES (`emit(node.questionToken)`/`colonToken` in the
   conditional route, 118486-118511) — those record as ordinary node
   boundaries, and the independent review's decode of
   `plain-program--positive-expression-density` confirms all four
   `?`/`:` segments; `writeTokenNode` sites (binary operators) are
   correctly unmapped in the decodes.
3. **Comment bytes map around themselves** (all five upstream comment
   writers call `emitPos(commentPos)`/`emitPos(commentEnd)`);
   synthesized comments do not.
4. **The generator's dedup collapses overlaps** (statement-start vs
   token-leading at the same position; block-After vs close-brace
   trailing) — landed and byte-proven in m-1.

## 4. Pinned chokepoint map (verified at authoring)

Rust funnel (all `crates/emitter/src/printer.rs`; line refs at the
trusted base):

- **Node phase — 2 insertions + 2 deletions.** Every recursive child
  emission funnels through `emit_node_with_hint_and_source_comments`
  (:8982, exactly two callers), whose five branches call
  `emit_substituted_node_with_comments` (:9346) = the upstream
  `pipelineEmitWithComments` shape: substituted leading metadata →
  `emit_transformed_node` (:9360) → synthetic trailing comments. The
  bracket goes INSIDE `emit_transformed_node` (:1533, around the worker
  call at :1558) and inside the one bypass,
  `emit_substituted_node_with_forwarded_source_comments` (:9368, around
  :9385) — this nests the map phase between the comment phases for all
  five branches plus the no-ASI forwarding lane. The statement-level
  pair at :1389/:1403 is DELETED (its :1403 AfterNode fired after
  `emit_statement_trailing_comments` — the upstream order violation the
  h2-6a.md gap row G2 named; the file-root statement loop's children now
  record through the same funnel as everything else). The range/flag
  logic of the existing `record_node_hook` (:12149) — NotEmittedStatement
  skip, NO_LEADING/TRAILING gates, `source_map_range` fallback to node
  pos/end, Before skip-trivia — carries over verbatim into the new
  writer-based record fn, plus the two missing guards: the JSON-source
  guard and the `EmitContext` `nested_source_maps_suppressed` extent
  (set where `NO_NESTED_COMMENTS` does it today, :1548-1556 pattern,
  from `EmitFlags::NO_NESTED_SOURCE_MAPS`).
- **Token phase — a ROUTE TABLE, not one unconditional bracket**
  (rewritten per review finding F1: the boundary fn carries EVERY token
  kind — keywords, parens, semicolons — and unconditional recording
  would over-record massively, while most upstream-mapped tokens bypass
  it entirely). The upstream-mapped surface lands at these Rust sites:
  | upstream site | Rust site(s) | rule |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `emitTokenWithComment` brace arm (118748) | `emit_token_with_comments_at_boundary` :11266 bracket, GUARDED to `FixedToken` kind ∈ {OpenBrace, CloseBrace} | records with `token_source_map_ranges` override consulted BEFORE the synthetic early-out (:11232) — a synthetic-cursor token WITH a real override records (review F6; the class witness's synthetic constructor close brace g18:4/5 is exactly this), and a failed `token_end` conversion keeps the arithmetic position and still records After |
  | `emitBlockStatements` braces (118587/118596) | the Block arm's direct `write_punctuation("{"/"}")` at :5683/:5944 | both record, EXCEPT the function-body open brace (`is_function_body_block`, :5684 — upstream emits it via bare `writePunctuation`, unmapped), whose close brace still records (119030) |
  | `emitCaseBlock` braces (119176/119178) | `emit_case_block` :6004/:6059 | both record |
  | `debugger` keyword (118931) | :1671 `write_keyword("debugger")` | records |
  | single-statement clause colon (119491) | the single-statement colon site inside the clause route (the boundary-fn caller distinguishes the polarity; ONLY that site records — the multi-statement colon stays unmapped) | records |
  | conditional `?`/`:` token NODES (118486-118511) | the fixed-token writes at :3294 region | record as node-boundary pairs at the token's own pos/end (upstream pipelines them as nodes) |
  | meta-property keyword (118571) | NO worker arm exists (unchanged `MetaProperty` streams via the fallback) | DEFERRED with owner: unwitnessed (review F9), lands as a ca-1 burn-down row; the fallback cannot record and the packet does not invent an arm without a witness |
  Every recording site honors `NO_TOKEN_LEADING/TRAILING_SOURCE_MAPS`
  and passes the authoritative `TransformSourceId` explicitly. An audit
  step (§7.2b) greps the worker for further upstream `emit(node.…Token)`
  pipelined-token sites and dispositions each (record/unmapped/defer)
  in the §8-A implementation record.
- **Comment phase — 1 insertion (+ the triple-slash edge).**
  `write_source_comment` (:13002) is the single source-comment byte
  writer (11 transformed-arm callers). Record before/after the written
  bytes. `write_synthetic_comment` (:13197) records nothing (upstream).
  The triple-slash lane (`write_comment_with_normalized_newlines`,
  :13089, one caller :12891) records via its caller with the threaded
  base offset. Threading: `SourceTrivia` (:317) gains the
  `TransformSourceId`; ~11 free-fn signatures updated (the one
  signature-churn cluster in this rung).
- **State:** `SourceMapRecording { source: TransformSourceId,
  source_index: u32, registered: memo, suppressed_depth: u32,
  generator: SourceMapGenerator }` lives in
  `TextWriter.recording: Option<…>`; the source-switch lane
  (`emitSourcePos` save/restore for a foreign `range.source`) is a
  method on the recording state; source registration happens at print
  start (the empty-file witness pins `sources:["input.ts"]` with zero
  mappings). **Suppression (review F5):** upstream's
  `sourceMapsDisabled` mutable flag suppresses node, TOKEN, and
  COMMENT records inside a `NO_NESTED_SOURCE_MAPS` subtree; token and
  comment writers receive no `EmitContext`, so the suppression carrier
  is `suppressed_depth` ON the recording state (incremented/decremented
  by the node bracket around the suppressed subtree — upstream's exact
  save/restore shape, permitted by §11's writer-slot model); no
  `EmitContext` extent is added. **Zero-width wrapper ranges (review
  F4):** upstream `(pos=-1, end)` / `(pos, end=-1)` partial ranges are
  encoded by the es2015 lowering as zero-width Original ranges
  (`es2015.rs:8837-8869`), and a verbatim carryover would record
  phantom Befores the frozen class witness lacks (its wrapper segments
  are After-only). The upstream semantics "this side has no map" is
  expressed with the EXISTING flags: the es2015 producer sites
  additionally set `NO_LEADING_SOURCE_MAP` (for the `(end,end)` form)
  / `NO_TRAILING_SOURCE_MAP` (for the `(pos,pos)` form) — flag-based,
  upstream-identical, no range-type change (`es2015.rs` enters the
  envelope for exactly these producer sites). `SourceMapGenerator`
  line/character inputs come from the existing
  `SourceUtf16Location::from_byte` conversion (`position.rs:141`)
  exactly as the deleted hooks did.
- **The no-ASI parsed-parenthesis arm (review F7):**
  `ParenthesizedNoAsiExpression::Parsed` (:9274-:9337) emits its
  wrapper as metadata + positioned paren tokens + child WITHOUT passing
  either node bracket; upstream pipelines the parsed parenthesized
  expression (the decoded expression-density parens pair g3:36/g3:54).
  The arm gets its own node-boundary bracket around the wrapper
  emission.

Upstream authority for every rule above: the
[h2-6a.md §4.3/§14 pins](h2-6a.md#4-pinned-upstream-map) plus the five
`writeToken` sites and `emitTokenWithComment` (118731-118764) read at
this base; no new `_tsc.js` spans beyond those.

## 5. Deletions (the replaced seam) and the enumerated cascade

Deleted: `SourceMapRecorder`, `DisabledSourceMapRecorder`,
`SourceMapHookEvent`, `SourceMapHookPhase` (`SourceMapObservation`
stays — outcome slot, m-3), `record_node_hook`/`record_token_hook`
(replaced by the writer-based fns), the identity-arm
`scan_byte_tokens` recording stream and its token-hook sites, and the
`Printer::print`/`print_source_file` recorder parameters.

**The compile cascade is ENUMERATED, not discovered (review F2)** —
every consumer of the deleted names at the trusted base:
- production: `crates/emitter/src/execute.rs` (:9 import + :375
  argument → `None`; two mechanical lines, no behavior);
- emitter unit suites (5) and emitter integration contracts (7) plus
  `crates/emitter/tests/source_comment_topology_contract.rs` — each
  passes a recorder today; their calls flip to the new
  `print(…, recording: None)` shape mechanically;
- `crates/checker/tests/unit/emit/tests.rs` — same mechanical flip
  (the envelope carries a PATH-LEVEL exception for exactly this file;
  the `crates/checker` prefix stays otherwise forbidden);
- `crates/emitter/tests/integration/printer_oracle_contract.rs` — the
  one NON-mechanical repair: it implements the old trait and asserts
  `BeforeToken` hook events on the identity arm. Decision: its
  hook-event assertions are DELETED WITH THE SEAM (the identity arm
  records nothing under the new model and is unreachable in compiler
  emit); its printed-byte oracle assertions stand unchanged; the
  h1-printer-foundation artifact re-mints in the walk exactly as any
  printer-byte change does (its pins are byte-addressed, not
  hook-semantic).
`tsc_emitter` re-exports updated. The compiler remains the fail-closed
backstop for anything the enumeration missed — but a miss is a packet
amendment, not an ad-hoc edit.

## 8. Frozen witnesses and suite

The replay suite lives at
`crates/compiler/tests/integration/source_map_recording_witness_contract.rs`
(review F3), with emitter-side unit contracts under the existing lib
target:

1. **Full-pipeline witness replays (the teeth):** for every parity-lane
   witness case with an external map (24) — build the program through
   the real pipeline exactly as `es2015_generators_witness_contract.rs`
   does (vendored lib inventory, production checker resolver), print
   with a `SourceMapRecording` injected (constructor inputs derived as
   m-1's replays: file basename, dir, sourceRoot ""), serialize via the
   m-1 generator, and byte-compare against the frozen
   `source_map_json` AND the frozen `.js` bytes under the EXPLICIT
   reconciliation rule (review F8): `printed_text` + the m-3-owned URL
   tail (one `newLine` when not at line start, then
   `//# sourceMappingURL=` + encodeURI'd map basename per the h2-6a.md
   §4.4 pins, reproduced as a TEST-LOCAL constant assembly — never a
   substitution inside printed bytes) must equal the frozen `.js`
   write. ×2 determinism. The fail-closed option mapper is EXTENDED for
   the witness floor's fields (all already exist on `CompilerOptions`):
   `sourceMap` (consumed by the TEST as the recording trigger only —
   the production refusal is untouched), `removeComments`, `outDir`,
   `resolveJsonModule`, `esModuleInterop`, `listEmittedFiles`,
   `emitBOM`, `noEmitOnError`, `downlevelIteration` — the mechanical
   extension set the review named.
2. **Adjacent controls:** the two WRITE-BEARING parity mapless cases
   (`plain-program--adjacent-negative-nomap`,
   `edge-shapes--adjacent-negative-shebang-nomap`) print with recording
   ABSENT and byte-match their frozen js; the two ZERO-WRITE cases
   (`fault-noemitonerror`, `json-self`) are print-unreachable and
   excluded (review F8's correction).
3. **Suppression contracts (emitter lib):** `NO_NESTED_SOURCE_MAPS`
   suppresses node AND token AND comment records inside the subtree
   (the F5 carrier); `NO_LEADING/TRAILING_SOURCE_MAP` and token-flag
   gates; the F4 zero-width flag pairing — all via focused synthetic
   trees with segment-presence/absence assertions through the
   generator (no hand-authored map bytes).
4. **Source-switch control (emitter lib):** a synthetic
   `source_map_range` naming a second source registers it and records
   against it (structural assert; the full multi-source lane stays
   H2.6b per the boundary table).

The W-H2.6A artifact remains the sole byte authority. No corpus
execution; production constructs no recording (corpus-inert).

## 8-A. Implementation-time amendments (2026-08-25)

1. **The harness-print bridge (stop-amend-resume).** Review F3 relocated
   the replay suite to `crates/compiler/tests/integration`, assuming the
   new `print(…, recording)` is reachable from there; at implementation
   `ProgramSession` exposed no printer-level surface (only whole-emit
   harness lanes), so the suite gains a typed bridge: (a)
   `crates/emitter/src/execute.rs` adds
   `print_script_units_with_recording` — the production plan → transform
   → print pipeline of `emit_files_with_activity` minus artifacts,
   sinks, and activity, returning per-unit `PrintedText` (recording
   injected per unit by the caller's selector; the option preflight is
   NOT consulted — the harness passes the witness options as-is and the
   production refusal lanes stay untouched for real emits); (b)
   `crates/compiler/src/lib.rs` adds
   `ProgramSession::print_units_with_source_map_recording_for_harness`
   wrapping the checker resolver exactly as the existing harness emit
   lanes do. Both are harness-only surfaces in the established
   `_for_harness` idiom; the envelope's `execute.rs` two-line limitation
   is widened to this function and `crates/compiler/src/lib.rs` enters
   `allowedPaths` for exactly the bridge method.
2. **Comment-lane threading simplification.** The packet's
   `SourceTrivia`/~11-signature threading was unnecessary: every
   source-comment byte funnels through `write_source_comment` (the
   triple-slash normalized-newlines path included, verified by caller
   census), whose `source: &str` IS the current file's text — the
   record positions are computed there directly with
   `compute_line_starts` (the writer's own line semantics), zero
   signatures changed.
3. **`printer_foundation_contract.rs` carried a second trait
   implementation** (beyond the enumerated `printer_oracle_contract`):
   its whole-source hook-phase test became the byte/position oracle
   plus a `source_map().is_none()` assert under the §5 decision; the
   oracle contract's token-coordinate block was deleted with the seam,
   its vendored byte/position oracle kept verbatim.
4. **Token-table deferrals recorded:** the single-statement clause
   colon record needs the same-line polarity hoisted above the colon
   write plus upstream comment-order pinning — witness-blind in this
   rung (§12c) and deferred to the m-3 witness-extension train with
   the `MetaProperty` keyword; the boundary-fn brace lane's
   invalid-end-boundary corner records nothing where upstream keeps an
   arithmetic position (unwitnessed; ca-1 adjudicates).
5. **Replay-falsified range/flag corrections (transform side).** The
   witness loop surfaced Rust-port deviations that were byte-inert
   before maps and are now load-bearing; each was corrected to the
   cited upstream form:
   - `create_partially_emitted_expression_positioned`: BOTH arms are
     end-only upstream — `EmitFlags::NO_LEADING_SOURCE_MAP` added to
     the `SkipTriviaOfPos` arm too (the F4 pairing had been read as
     one-arm-only).
   - `simplify_constructor` re-propagates the statements-array range on
     rebuild; the default-constructor body, IIFE-body site, and
     `members_end` read members from `get_original_node(node)` (visited
     class members arrays are rangeless).
   - The default-constructor `return Base;`: upstream sets an END-only
     range on the `PartiallyEmittedExpression` wrapper
     (`setTextRangeEnd`) and a POS-only range on the return statement
     (`setTextRangePos`); the two-sided Rust ranges carry
     `NO_LEADING_SOURCE_MAP` / `NO_TRAILING_SOURCE_MAP` respectively —
     the ONE-SIDED ENCODING now used everywhere a `moveRangePos`/
     `moveRangeEnd`/pos-or-end-only upstream range must survive on a
     node.
   - `transform_function_body` was skipping
     `setTextRange(createNodeArray(statements), statementsLocation)`
     ("byte-inert"); the statements-array range is the function-body
     close-brace map anchor and is now donated on rebuild.
     `set_block_statements_range_to_array` takes the donor's
     `TransformSourceId` (the donor block may live in the transform
     arena; all four call sites updated).
   - `hoistVariableDeclaration` sets `EmitFlags.NoNestedSourceMaps` on
     every hoisted declaration upstream; the Rust port stores NAMES and
     materializes declarations per transform, so the flag is applied at
     all six materialization sites (builtins.rs shared helpers ×2,
     es2015, es2017, es2018, generators — es2021 already had it).
   - es2015 `convertForOfStatementHead` (identifier arm): the binding
     statement is pos-only and its declaration list end-only upstream
     (`moveRangeEnd`/`moveRangePos` with `-1`); encoded as full range +
     side flags. The generators `visitVariableStatement` else-arm copy
     (`setSourceMapRange(statement, node)`) now carries the donor's
     side flags with the range — the price of the flag encoding: every
     cross-node copy of a one-sided range must copy its side flags.
   - `generateCallToConvertedLoop` passes the loop parameter's parsed
     name NODE as the call argument upstream; the arena clone stays and
     the donor's range rides as an explicit `source_map_range`.
6. **Replay-falsified printer corrections.** A synthesized
   `ConditionalExpression` carries factory `createToken` `?`/`:` nodes
   (pos −1): no boundary map, however real the neighboring token
   cursor looks. The `?`/`:` record lane in
   `emit_token_with_comments_at_boundary` is therefore gated on the
   parsed-similar owner test (`node_has_source_token_shape`) — without
   it the default-value conditional's colon recorded the source comma
   after the initializer. (Also landed from the loop: the
   function-body Block phantom-boundary skip and the HeritageClause
   leading-space relocation, both §4-route consequences.)
7. **Parse-error witness is a typed deferral.** The `fault-parse-error`
   witness reaches `ParseDiagnosticsDeferred` (H2.9) before printing;
   the suite pins that as
   `parse_error_witness_is_typed_deferred_to_h2_9` and the parity
   census is 23 replayed cases, not 24.
8. **§8.3/§8.4 harness technique.** The emitter-lib contracts print an
   untransformed parse with a `1_0` numeric-separator literal: the
   emission plan's literal-rewrite lane marks the ancestor chain
   structured, so the identity print pipelines every node (the
   parsed-tree fast path would otherwise stop recursion above the
   observed records and make suppression assertions vacuous). The
   source-switch control flags an INNER node with trailing siblings:
   a switched node whose boundary coincides with a sibling record is
   collapsed by the generator's same-generated-position overwrite
   (faithful upstream behavior), which the packet's original
   statement-level sketch missed.
